create_Sam3Processor: create a Sam3Processor instance for image and text preprocessing with bounding box support
run_Sam3Processor_call: run the Sam3Processor __call__ method to process images, text prompts, and input bounding boxes into model-ready tensors
build_post_process_semantic_segmentation: build semantic segmentation maps from Sam3Model outputs using configurable threshold and target image sizes
build_post_process_object_detection: build final bounding box predictions from Sam3Model outputs with score thresholding and size normalization
build_post_process_instance_segmentation: build instance segmentation results with bounding boxes, masks, and confidence scores from Sam3Model raw outputs
